prompt: A wide shot from slightly above, captured with an 85mm lens, reveals a dimly lit television studio, its evening studio lights casting a warm glow from the side. The woman, a woman in her early 20s with loose curly dark brown hair and rich brown skin, stands proudly to the left of centre, wearing an oversized black blazer. Her level and calm eyebrows frame bright and steady eyes that shine with a restrained smile, her jaw set in determination. Her chin is held high, her head level, and her posture is upright, with her shoulders back. One hand holds a trophy, the Emmy award, against her chest, a symbol of her nomination for hosting Saturday Night Live. The soft haze and bokeh of the background blur the details of the studio, focusing attention on the main subject. To the right, the television studio opens up, its vast space empty except for a distant hint of the Saturday Night Live. No text, no logos, no watermark.
alt: Illustration of a woman in television studio, lit by evening, studio lights.
